title: IYC workers protest outside Meta office in Gurugram, police use water cannons

ai.summary: IYC workers protested outside Meta office in Gurugram, alleging suppression of opposition voices on Meta's platforms, with police using water cannons to disperse them.

facts.claim: More than a hundred Indian Youth Congress (IYC) workers staged a demonstration in front of the Meta office here on Saturday
facts.quote: More than a hundred Indian Youth Congress (IYC) workers staged a demonstration in front of the Meta office here on Saturday

facts.claim: A huge police force was deployed in view of the protest led by IYC national president Uday Bhanu Chib
facts.quote: A huge police force was deployed in view of the protest led by IYC national president Uday Bhanu Chib

facts.claim: The protesters climbed onto barricades holding placards that read “Constitution of India, Withheld in India”
facts.quote: The protesters climbed onto barricades holding placards that read “Constitution of India, Withheld in India”

facts.claim: However, the demonstration was soon stopped by police, who used water cannons to disperse the demonstrators and took some of them into custody
facts.quote: However, the demonstration was soon stopped by police, who used water cannons to disperse the demonstrators and took some of them into custody

facts.claim: Some IYC workers alleged that police sprayed dirty water on the protesters, a claim the police denied
facts.quote: Some IYC workers alleged that police sprayed dirty water on the protesters, a claim the police denied

facts.claim: Following the protest, IYC president Uday Bhanu Chib alleged that voices of dissent are being suppressed through a deliberate strategy across Meta’s various platforms
facts.quote: Following the protest, IYC president Uday Bhanu Chib alleged that voices of dissent are being suppressed through a deliberate strategy across Meta’s various platforms

facts.claim: On November 19, Meta suspended the official Instagram accounts of Indian Youth Congress national president Uday Bhanu Chib and national in-charge Manish Sharma in India
facts.quote: On November 19, Meta suspended the official Instagram accounts of Indian Youth Congress national president Uday Bhanu Chib and national in-charge Manish Sharma in India

ai.background_note: IYC workers protested outside Meta offices in Gurugram, Mumbai, and Hyderabad after Meta suspended their social media accounts on November 19, claiming the accounts were subject to unlawful restrictions.
